mapper.sql: root (symbol_id, root_id, depth) AS ( SELECT s.symbol_id, s.symbol_id, 0 FROM analysis_symbol s WHERE s.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND s.outer_symbol_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT s.symbol_id, r.root_id, r.depth + 1 FROM root r JOIN analysis_symbol s ON s.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND s.outer_symbol_id = r.symbol_id WHERE r.depth < 20 ), type_node (symbol_id, node_id) AS ( -- 바깥 타입을 못 찾은 것(바깥 타입이 분석에서 빠진 경우)은 자기 자신을 묶음으로 삼는다. SELECT s.symbol_id , (CASE WHEN f.language = 'JSP' THEN 'F' || rs.file_id ELSE rs.symbol_id END)::text FROM analysis_symbol s LEFT JOIN (SELECT symbol_id, MIN(root_id) AS root_id FROM root GROUP BY symbol_id) r ON r.symbol_id = s.symbol_id JOIN analysis_symbol rs ON rs.revision_id = s.revision_id AND rs.symbol_id = COALESCE(r.root_id, s.symbol_id) JOIN analysis_file f ON f.file_id = rs.file_id WHERE s.revision_id = #{revisionId} ), member (member_id, node_id) AS ( SELECT t.symbol_id::text, t.node_id FROM type_node t UNION ALL SELECT m.method_id::text, t.node_id FROM analysis_method m JOIN type_node t ON t.symbol_id = m.owner_symbol_id WHERE m.revision_id = #{revisionId} UNION ALL SELECT d.field_id::text, t.node_id FROM analysis_field d JOIN type_node t ON t.symbol_id = d.owner_symbol_id WHERE d.revision_id = #{revisionId} UNION ALL SELECT 'S' || mp.mapper_id, 'M' || mp.file_id FROM analysis_mapper mp WHERE mp.revision_id = #{revisionId} UNION ALL SELECT 'F' || f.file_id, 'F' || f.file_id FROM analysis_file f WHERE f.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND f.language = 'JSP' )
(CASE ${column} WHEN 'HIGH' THEN 3 WHEN 'MEDIUM' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END)
(CASE ${column} WHEN 3 THEN 'HIGH' WHEN 2 THEN 'MEDIUM' ELSE 'LOW' END)
(CASE WHEN strpos(${column}, '/') > 0 THEN regexp_replace(${column}, '/[^/]*$', '') ELSE '(루트)' END)
mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE SELECT x.* FROM ( SELECT s.symbol_id::text AS "id" , 'TYPE' AS "kind" , s.kind::text AS "subType" , s.simple_name::text AS "name" , s.fqn::text AS "fullName" , COALESCE(NULLIF(s.package_name, ''), '(기본 패키지)')::text AS "group" , s.layer::text AS "layer" , f.path::text AS "path" , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM analysis_method m WHERE m.revision_id = s.revision_id AND m.owner_symbol_id = s.symbol_id AND NOT m.is_synthetic)::int AS "size" FROM analysis_symbol s JOIN analysis_file f ON f.file_id = s.file_id WHERE s.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND s.symbol_id IN (SELECT t.node_id FROM type_node t) UNION ALL SELECT 'F' || f.file_id, 'JSP', 'JSP', regexp_replace(f.path, '^.*/', ''), f.path , , 'VIEW', f.path, COALESCE(f.line_count, 0) FROM analysis_file f WHERE f.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND f.language = 'JSP' UNION ALL -- 이름은 네임스페이스의 마지막 마디(com.shop.OrderDao → OrderDao). 네임스페이스가 없으면 파일 이름 SELECT 'M' || f.file_id, 'MAPPER', MIN(mp.mapper_type) , COALESCE(NULLIF(regexp_replace(MIN(mp.namespace), '^.*\.', ''), ''), regexp_replace(f.path, '^.*/', '')) , COALESCE(NULLIF(MIN(mp.namespace), ''), f.path) , , 'MAPPER', f.path, (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE mp.statement_type <> 'SQL_FRAGMENT'))::int FROM analysis_mapper mp JOIN analysis_file f ON f.file_id = mp.file_id WHERE mp.revision_id = #{revisionId} GROUP BY f.file_id, f.path UNION ALL SELECT 'T:' || r.to_external, 'TABLE', 'TABLE', r.to_external, r.to_external, '(테이블)', 'TABLE', NULL, COUNT(*)::int FROM analysis_relation r WHERE r.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND r.to_kind = 'TABLE' AND r.to_external IS NOT NULL GROUP BY r.to_external ) x ORDER BY x."kind", x."group", x."name" LIMIT #{limit}

WITH RECURSIVE SELECT e.src AS "from" , e.dst AS "to" , e.relation_type AS "type" , COUNT(*)::int AS "count" , AS "confidence" FROM ( SELECT src.node_id AS src , COALESCE(dst.node_id, 'T:' || r.to_external) AS dst , r.relation_type , AS conf FROM analysis_relation r JOIN member src ON src.member_id = r.from_id LEFT JOIN member dst ON dst.member_id = r.to_id WHERE r.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND r.relation_type IN #{type} AND (dst.node_id IS NOT NULL OR (r.to_kind = 'TABLE' AND r.to_external IS NOT NULL)) ) e WHERE e.src <> e.dst GROUP BY e.src, e.dst, e.relation_type ORDER BY e.src, e.dst, e.relation_type LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT n.node_id::text AS "id" , n.node_type::text AS "kind" , n.sub_type::text AS "subType" , n.name::text AS "name" , n.fqn::text AS "fullName" , (CASE WHEN n.node_type IN ('METHOD', 'FIELD') THEN o.simple_name END)::text AS "owner" , o.layer::text AS "layer" , f.path::text AS "path" , n.line_start AS "lineStart" FROM kg_node n LEFT JOIN analysis_file f ON f.file_id = n.file_id LEFT JOIN analysis_method m ON m.revision_id = n.revision_id AND m.method_id = n.node_id LEFT JOIN analysis_field d ON d.revision_id = n.revision_id AND d.field_id = n.node_id LEFT JOIN analysis_symbol o ON o.revision_id = n.revision_id AND o.symbol_id = COALESCE(m.owner_symbol_id, d.owner_symbol_id, n.node_id) WHERE n.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND n.node_id IN #{id}

SELECT e.endpoint_type AS "endpointType" , e.http_method AS "httpMethod" , e.path AS "path" , m.method_id AS "methodId" , m.signature AS "signature" FROM analysis_endpoint e LEFT JOIN analysis_method m ON m.revision_id = e.revision_id AND m.method_id = e.method_id WHERE e.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND (e.method_id = #{nodeId} OR e.symbol_id = #{nodeId} OR m.owner_symbol_id = #{nodeId}) ORDER BY e.path, e.http_method LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT f.file_id AS "fileId" , f.path AS "path" , f.language AS "language" , f.file_type AS "fileType" , f.line_count AS "lineCount" FROM analysis_file f WHERE f.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND f.file_id = #{fileId}

SELECT m.method_id AS "methodId" , m.signature AS "signature" , m.line_start AS "lineStart" , m.is_synthetic AS "isSynthetic" FROM analysis_method m WHERE m.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND m.file_id = #{fileId} ORDER BY m.line_start, m.signature
mapper.sql: 'S' || mp.mapper_id AS "id" , COALESCE(mp.namespace || '.', '') || mp.statement_id AS "statement" , mp.statement_type AS "statementType" , mp.mapper_type AS "mapperType" , mp.namespace AS "namespace" , f.path AS "path" , mp.line_start AS "lineStart" , mp.line_end AS "lineEnd" -- 건드리는 테이블. 읽으면 (R), 쓰면 (C/U/D) , (SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT t.to_external || '(' || (CASE WHEN t.relation_type = 'READS_TABLE' THEN 'R' ELSE COALESCE(t.properties_json->>'crud', 'W') END) || ')', ', ') FROM analysis_relation t WHERE t.revision_id = mp.revision_id AND t.from_id = 'S' || mp.mapper_id AND t.relation_type IN ('READS_TABLE', 'WRITES_TABLE')) AS "tables"
mapper.select: SELECT FROM analysis_mapper mp JOIN analysis_file f ON f.file_id = mp.file_id WHERE mp.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND mp.file_id = #{fileId} AND mp.statement_type <> 'SQL_FRAGMENT' ORDER BY mp.line_start, mp.statement_id
